description: Unified AI assistant with Agentic RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) capabilities, combining vector search (PostgreSQL/Supabase + pgvector), knowledge graph (Neo4j + Graphiti), and intelligent routing. Built with Pydantic AI.

1.name: Knowledge Graph Improvements
1.description: Transform the knowledge graph from a disconnected entity index into a fully queryable temporal knowledge base with document references, temporal metadata, entity deduplication, numeric facts, relationship scoring, and type hierarchy.
